Public API for the Nebulock AI threat-hunting platform: Findings, Entities (actors/users/hosts), Hunts, hunt suggestions/reports, and detection Rules. Available to active Nebulock customers. Authentication uses per-organization API keys passed in the X-API-Key-ID and X-API-Key-Secret headers. Rate limit: 60 requests per minute.
